text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My first three years with Satono Diamond came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was able to achieve solid results
in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, striving to become the 'Great Umamusume' of her ideals,
her days of forging relentlessly ahead continue—"

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Anyone home?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Rice-san, Bourbon-san! I request a direct showdown with the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"What race are you running in next!?
We're gonna enter that one too!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hyaii!?
Wh-Wh-What is it!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I want to compete against the two of you
with everything on the line!
Not in a mock race, but on the real stage!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-Why are you with Rice and the others...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, we were blessed with the opportunity
to compete against both McQueen-san
and Teio-san."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I learned so much from both of you
in that race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am still quite inexperienced... so I felt
I needed to run alongside accomplished runners like all of you
and hone myself even further.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And when I asked Teio-san and the others for advice,
they told me I should try running against Rice-san and Bourbon-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: They said it'd be a great learning experience!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I have no objections to your proposal.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A race with the two of you will surely be meaningful for me as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, uh...
I-If you're okay with Rice as your opponent...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: P-Pleased to be working with you!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thank goodness!
Thank you both so much!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No. Rice is just... really looking forward to running with Satono-san, Kita-san, and Bourbon-san too...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, me too.
I will contact you after considering
the optimal race to enter.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, Rice-san,
I've gone and arranged a race
with Bourbon-san for you♪”
choice_data_list: From now on, tell me before you go...
From now on, let me know before you go...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Satono Diamond's report,
I can't help but hold my head in my hands. It sounds just like a dojo challenger.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I will make a formal request
to Rice Shower and Mihono Bourbon later.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In that case, may I ask you to handle
future negotiations, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Next, I'd like to run with Hayahide-san and the rest of the BNW trio.
Oh, I've already made plans with Nature-san and the others♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And then there's Spe-san and Suzuka-san...
I'd love to compete against Golshi-san too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And with Rudolf-san, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, to reach the top of the nation,
there are so many people
we must compete against, aren't there?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond says with genuine joy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a "great Umamusume"—
First, alongside Kitasan Black, I will aim for the top of the nation and challenge the strong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That is Satono Diamond's current goal.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To pursue the strength and demeanor
befitting a "great Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's make today's training great too,
Trainer!!
